A '''gaxxan brain-slug''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Slug (creature)/Legends|slug]] that was capable of [[Death/Legends|killing]] an individual. At least one of the creatures was small enough to be left on a [[Pillow/Legends|pillow]].<ref name="kotor" /> The gaxxan [[Brain/Legends|brain]]-slug was [[Homeworld/Legends|indigenous]] to the [[Gaxxa system/Legends|Gaxxa system]], located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="Atlas" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> By [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="KotORDate">The ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' to [[3956 BBY]].</ref> the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Jurgan Kalta]] had been killed by a gaxxan brain-slug that was left on his pillow. The mercenary's custom [[Jurgan Kalta's power suit|power suit]] had prevented his enemies from succeeding with more conventional attacks.<ref name="kotor" />

==Behind the scenes==
The gaxxan brain-slug was first mentioned in the [[2003]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', in the item description for Jurgan Kalta's [[Power armor/Legends|power suit]].<ref name="kotor" /> Jurgan Kalta's entry in the [[2008]] reference title ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' misspells the species name as "gaxxon brain-slug."<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|196|Kalta, Jurgan}}</ref>
